t: This is the Royal Ballet School, in Richmond upon Thames, a school of classical ballet training. It was founded in 1926 by Ninette de Valois, the Irish-born dancer, teacher and choreographer who had danced with Diaghilev's Ballets Russes. Its aim is to train outstanding classical dancers, especially for the Royal Ballet and the Birmingham Royal Ballet. De Valois also established both of those companies, and she is widely regarded as the godmother of English and Irish ballet. So everything you see here grows from her work.
